issues.explanation: Route placeholders are {entity} but the priorities and ticket actions declare string $entitySlug, so Laravel cannot resolve that argument and those two endpoints fail instead of returning the specified contract.
TrimStrings expects a list of field names, so passing a request-matching closure never matches and the intended api/* trim exemption is ineffective, leaving the ' 123456' => 400 edge case at risk.
Queue IDs from the JWT claim are coerced with array_map('intval'), so malformed claim values are silently normalized instead of rejected before scope intersection.
A missing JWT secret throws RuntimeException from decode(), producing a 500 rather than the specified 401 invalid_token closed response.
Both a custom TotemCors middleware and a new config/cors.php are added for the same localhost-only policy, leaving two CORS sources where one suffices.
Failure audit uses the global request() helper while the method already has $request, hurting consistency and testability.

conventions.evidence: Migrations have reversible down() and Fillable/HasFactory models; PairTotem action plus IssueTicket reuse follow Actions guidance; docs/CHANGELOG/.env.example updated; deviation is bootstrap trimStrings(except: [closure]) which expects field names, not a request matcher.

readability.evidence: Small focused classes (TotemJwt, TicketPriority, TotemApiController::resolveQueue/entityMismatch); clear names and PHPDoc; nits are the unused $entitySlug parameter name and request() vs $request inconsistency.

requirements.evidence: Pairing transaction with lockForUpdate, HS256 claims totem_id/entity_id/preset_id/queues/iat/exp/jti, intersection scope, throttles 10/1 and 30/1, CORS preflight, factories and docs all present; but routes/api.php uses {entity} while TotemPriorityController::index() and TotemTicketController::store() declare string $entitySlug, so those endpoints cannot resolve, plus the trim exemption for ' 123456' uses the wrong middleware API.

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves pairing/JWT/endpoints/rate-limit/CORS/audit/docs/CHANGELOG; no unrelated refactors or unasked features; entity_suspended stays reserved and never sent.

security.evidence: No code oracle (single invalid_pairing_code), lockForUpdate + transaction, hash_equals + HS256-only check, audit logs assert no full code, mass-assignment via Fillable, CORS without credentials; gaps are intval coercion of queues claim and secret-missing 500 instead of 401.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses App\Actions\IssueTicket with TicketChannel::Totem, single-source TicketPriority for endpoint plus validation, small dependency-free HS256 as allowed; minor duplication is custom TotemCors plus config/cors.php.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/TotemPairingTest.php (pairing window, 400/401 matrix, single-use, rate limit, no-code audit), TotemApiTest.php (queues ordering, 403/404/422 matrix, intersection scope, A001/A002 sequential, channel totem), TotemCorsTest.php (preflight 204, unknown origin no header, rate-limit CORS), TotemSchemaTest.php (factory/pivot/config).

review.summary: The change implements the full totem BFF (pairing, HS256 JWT, four endpoints, throttles, audit logging, localhost CORS, schema and docs) with strong tests. It needs changes before merging because the priorities/ticket controller parameter name ($entitySlug vs {entity}) breaks route resolution and the TrimStrings exemption uses the wrong API.
